application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
description: Variation of condition 4 (approved plans) to allow alteration to position of giant video screens following planning permission 00703/A/P11 dated 12/06/2014 for Hybrid Planning Application for Brentford Football Club for: Full Planning Permission for the demolition of all existing buildings and the erection of a stadium with ancillary accommodation (D2 Use Class), associated infrastructure including a new vehicular and pedestrian bridge from the eastern corner of the site into Capital interchange Way, reopening of an existing pedestrian underpass from Kew Bridge Station beneath Lionel Road South and the construction of a new covered, open sided link from that underpass to the stadium beneath Lionel Road South and the construction of a new covered, open sided link from that underpass to the stadium external concourse, vehicular and pedestrian circulation areas, public realm improvements, 60 car parking spaces, 400 cycle parking spaces and landscaping; and Outline Planning Permission for the demolition of all existing buildings and erection of associated enabling development, comprising residential units (C3 Use Class), retail/other floorspace (A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, D1 and D2 Use Classes), a hotel (C1 Use Class), vehicular and pedestrian circulation areas, up to 775 car parking spaces, cycle parking, associated hard and soft landscaping and public and private amenity spaces (all matters reserved)
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development commenced on 22 March 2017.

Condition : 3 - Approval in writing by the Local Planning Authority of the details of the layout, scale and appearance of the building(s), the means of access thereto and the landscaping (hereinafter called "the reserved matters") shall be obtained from the Local Planning Authority for each phase requiring reserved matters approval, prior to the development commencing in that specific phase.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application (listed above) and the plans submitted therewith or as shall have been otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the buildings are occupied.

Condition : 5 - The outline development hereby granted approval and any subsequent reserved matters shall not exceed the maximum parameters with regards to footprint, height, floorspace and volume, as shown on the approved plans, and the maximum number of dwellings shall not exceed 910 dwellings.

Condition : 6 - The total floorspace areas of the uses hereby approved shall be limited to the following:
(i) Stadium (D2 use) including ancillary uses within the stadium building: 27,014sqm gross internal area (excludes canopy area) Within the stadium the ancillary uses shall not include:
(i) Places of worship, creches or day nurseries greater than 100 sq. metres in floor area (within class D1)
(ii) Hotel (C1 use): 7,000sqm gross internal area
(iii) Community facilities (D1 use): 1,020 sqm gross internal area
(iv) Other uses (non-stadium): 1,500 sqm gross internal area
The other uses (non-stadium) shall be for one or more of the following uses of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, as amended, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification, with change allowed between these permitted uses for up to ten years following first occupation of any unit:
(i) Class A1: all uses	
(ii) Class A2: all uses
(iii) Class A3: all uses
(iv) Class A4: all uses
(v) Class A5; all uses
(vi) Class B1; all uses
(vii) Class D1: all uses except places of worship.
(viii) Class D2: all uses except cinemas, music and concert halls, dance halls, skating rinks, bingo halls.
In respect of any of the above Class D1 uses hereby approved, notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, as amended, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification; the use shall not be changed to a place of worship without further approval in writing from the Local Planning Authority. In respect of the above Class D2 uses hereby approved, notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, as amended, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification; the u

Condition : 7 - In respect of the Class D2 use of the stadium hereby approved, notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, as amended, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification; the stadium bowl (ie the pitch and spectator terraced seats) shall not be used for events for the purpose of:
(i) A standalone musical performance utilising the pitch.

Condition : 8 - Apart from the stadium, hotel and its ancillary uses, the non-residential floor space and uses hereby permitted shall not be open to customers/ members of the public outside the hours of 8:00am to 11:00pm Monday to Saturday and 9:00am to 11:00pm on Sundays and Public Holidays.
The stadium shall not hold major events (football matches) outside the hours of 9:00am to 11:00pm. Ancillary uses within the stadium building shall not be open to customers/members of the public outside the hours of 8:00am to 1:00am Monday to Saturday and
10:00am to 11:00pm on Sundays, Bank Holidays and Public Holidays, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 9 - All dwellings within the outline development hereby approved shall be designed to meet the relevant minimum Baseline Standards and aim to meet 'Good Practice' standards of the Housing Supplementary Planning Guidance 2012 (Mayor of London), and all dwellings shall meet the 16 Lifetime Homes Standards. No more than 10% of the total dwellings within the development shall be single aspect north facing units.
Dwellings shall be completed in accordance with the details in the approved Design and Access Statement (September 2017), the approved Design and Access Statement (July 2015) and any future reserved matters approvals. Standards shall be maintained permanently thereafter.
Condition : 10 - Details of the stadium, landscaping, infrastructure and public realm, and reserved matters, shall be consistent with the approved 'Design Code Revision A', dated 23 September 2013.

Condition : 11 - Detailed drawings of windows, balconies and privacy screens for all dwellings in each outline phase shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority prior to any works above ground for each phase. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any such approval unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 12 - The development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the following details:
"	Blocks E&F Basement Level - KEW-BMA-EF-01-DR-A-0399-Rev P3;
"	Blocks E&F Ground Level - KEW-BMA-EF-00-DR-A-0300-Rev P4;
"	Blocks E&F North East Elevation - KEW-BMA-EF-XX-DR-A-0505-Rev P4
"	Network Rail Survey (Structure Survey Reference 7/14A); and
"	Network Rail Survey (Structure Reference X7/40A).
The underpass shall be constructed in accordance with the approved details and completed prior to the first use of the stadium and maintained in accordance with the details thereafter. Should the phasing require that the permanent underpass be completed following the first use of the stadium, details of any temporary arrangements for access to the underpass shall be submitted to the Council for approval. The underpass shall be open to pedestrians, including members of the public, at all times, unless otherwise agreed in the Stadium Management Plan.

Condition : 14 - No demolition of Griffin Park stadium, Brentford, shall commence until the Football Stadium hereby approved achieves Practical Completion to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 16 - Full details of the Learning Zone and its operation shall be submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to occupation of Block G. It shall be completed and available for use in accordance with the approved details within 3 months of occupation of Block G and maintained in accordance with the approved details thereafter unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 17 - Full details of the educational use of the community facilities in Block G and its operation shall be submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to occupation of Block G. It shall be completed and available for use in accordance with the approved details within 3 months of occupation of Block G and maintained in accordance with the approved details thereafter unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 18 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am to 6:00pm on Monday to Friday and 9:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays, Bank Holidays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 19 - The development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the following approved details relating to 'Secured by Design':
"	Secure by Design Principles Proposals Rev. B 20.09.2019 (Stadium Phase). Approved 08.11.19;
"	Secure by Design Principles - Brentford Community Stadium: Design Report, Annex 1 - Drawings, Annex 2 - MEP Services, KEW-BMA-GH-00-DR-A-0300 Revision P3 (Central Southern and Central Eastern Residential Phase). Approved 31.05.19; and
"	Design out Crime Strategy June 2019 (Capital Court Residential Phase). Approved 09.07.20.
Details of how the buildings, open spaces and car parking shall address 'Secured by Design' principles for all future phases of the development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the first occupation of each building of the development.

Condition : 22 - Deliveries and servicing of the site shall only take place between the hours of 6:00am and 9:00pm Monday to Saturday and 7:00am to 9:00pm on Sundays, Bank Holidays or Public Holidays, apart from servicing of the stadium on match-days, where deliveries and servicing may occur from 6:00am to 11:00pm. Details of the scheduling and traffic management measures for the Outdoor Broadcasting Facility on Lionel Road South shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the first use of that facility.

Condition : 24 - The development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the following details:
(i) Kew Bridge Gate Developments LLP, Brentford Community Stadium Remediation Strategy for Contamination (Ref. BGCL-C15037/001/v6) Dated February 2017, Received 28 February 2017.
During the course of the development:
(ii) The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues. Before the development is first brought into use:
(iii) The agreed decontamination scheme referred to above, including amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.

Condition : 25 - The development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the following details:
(i) Thames Water Drawing (Ref: 50037616 Rev 7), dated 22/09/19.
Where new infrastructure is required this shall be implemented in accordance with approval given in writing, prior to occupation of each phase of the development.

(i) Bird Hazard Management dated 2017.
The Bird Hazard Management Plan shall be implemented as approved prior to occupation of each phase of the development and shall remain in force for the life of each building. No subsequent alterations to the plan are to take place unless first submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

(ii) Sewer Impact Assessment on Thames Water Infrastructure for Proposed Development: Brentford Community Stadium, Lionel Road (Dated 11 August 2016) Received 23 August 2016.

Landscaping shall be completed in accordance with the approved details prior to the first occupation of each phase in accordance with this condition.

Prior to the occupation of each additional phase of the development an external lighting strategy and details of CCTV for that phase of the development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Lighting and CCTV for each phase shall be completed in accordance with the approved strategy for each phase prior to occupation of that phase, and shall be maintained in accordance with the approved details permanently thereafter.

Condition : 36 - The development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the following details relating to refuse and recycling: 
"	Waste Management Plan Issue A 11 February 2020. Received: 25/03/2020. Stadium Phase - Approved 20.05.20; and
"	Waste Management Strategy (Update) July 2020. Received: 29/07/2020. Capital Court Phase - Approved 14.09.20. 
Prior to the occupation of each further phase of the development, details of the arrangements for storage and collection of refuse and recycling for the approved dwellings and uses, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be completed in accordance with the approved details prior to occupation of each phase, and shall be maintained permanently thereafter.

Condition : 37 - Noise emitted from any fixed plant on site shall be at least 10dB lower than the existing background noise level as measured at the nearest noise sensitive location outside the site and the measurement should be made in accordance with BS4142:1997.

Condition : 38 - No residential unit shall be occupied until details of a scheme of mitigation for exposure to poor air quality for each unit to ensure exposure to air pollution does not exceed national air quality objectives, with regards to 'London Council's Air Quality and Planning Guidance', has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, and the approved details have been completed. Any system of mitigation shall be designed to prevent summer overheating and minimise energy usage and to demonstrate that the internal air quality is satisfactory with the annual mean concentration of NO2 to not exceed 40 ug/m3. The approved details shall be fully implemented prior to the occupation of each unit and thereafter permanently retained and maintained. The maintenance and cleaning of the systems shall be undertaken regularly in accordance with manufacturer specifications, and shall be the responsibility of the primary owner of the property. The development shall not include biomass boilers.

Condition : 39 - No residential unit shall be occupied until details have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority of a scheme providing for the insulation of the proposed dwellings against the transmission of externally generated road and rail noise (and vibration), taking account of any ventilation requirements necessary, in order to ensure that the maximum noise levels permitted within the dwelling rooms do not exceed those that are specified in Table 4 of BS8233 (2014) [Living Rooms= 35 dB; LAeq, 16 hours; Dining room/area = 40 dB LAeq, 16 hours; Bedroom = 35 dB LAeq, 16 hours during day-time (07:00 - 23:00) and Bedroom = 30 dB LAeq, 8 hours during night-time (23:00 - 07:00)]. The scheme shall take account of any noise from mechanical ventilation necessary for the units.

Condition : 41 - (A) The development hereby permitted shall be built in accordance with the arrangements for accessibility to the Football Stadium, detailed within Sections 2.1.13 and 2.1.14 of the approved Design and Access Statement (September 2017).
(B) The development hereby permitted shall be built in accordance with the arrangements for accessibility, detailed within the following documents:
"	Planning Conditions Discharge Report / Condition 41b - Accessibility - Received 14/06/2019. Approved 30.07.19. Central Southern and Central Eastern Residential Phase;
"	01530E_PC-10 Accessibility Strategy - 109/09/2019, 01530E_PC-11 Accessibility Strategy - 2 09/09/2019, 01530E_PC-12 Accessibility Strategy - 3 09/09/2019, 01530E_PC-13 Accessibility Strategy - 4 09/09/2019, 01530E_PC-14 Accessibility Strategy - 5 09/09/2019, 01530E_PC-15 Accessibility Strategy - 6 09/09/2019. Received: 14/02/2020. Approved 30.04.20. Capital Court Residential Phase.
(C) Prior to works above ground details of the arrangements for accessibility for disabled people to the buildings and facilities for that phase shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 42 - (A) The Stadium development hereby permitted shall be built in accordance with the details of the arrangements for and management of coach parking, and taxi pick up and drop areas provided within the approved Design and Access Statement (September 2017) and the WSP Transport Assessment Addendum (September 2017).
(B) The development hereby permitted shall be built in accordance with the arrangements for taxi pick up and drop areas, waiting restrictions and use of lay-bys, detailed within the following documents:
"	Brentford Community Stadium: Condition 42 - Coach and Taxi Parking and Drop-Off Areas dated 10 June 2019. Received: 25/06/2019. Central Southern and Central Eastern Residential Phase. Approved 26.06.19;
(C) No development of any further outline phase shall commence above ground, until details of arrangements for taxi pick up and drop areas for that phase, waiting restrictions and use of lay-bys, including any coach parking necessary for the hotel, has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 43 - (A) Cycle parking for the detailed phase of the development shall be provided in accordance with the approved details provided in drawings: P112288-00-007-815 (Site Wide Intermediate Cycle Parking Strategy) and P112288-00-007-814 (Site Wide Cycle Parking Strategy), prior to the first use of the stadium. These facilities are to be permanently maintained thereafter and available free for members of the public to use outside match times.
(B) Notwithstanding the approved plans, details of cycle parking for each residential block of the outline development including the routes to the stores shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the first occupation of any unit in that block.
Condition : 44 - The Stadium development hereby permitted shall be built in accordance with the anti-terrorism measures approved on 24.09.19.

The PA system shall be operated in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 47 - All works affecting the public highway are to be carried out in accordance with the approved S278/S38 agreement. The approved works shall be completed in accordance with the local planning authority's written approval and have been certified in the writing as complete (defined as receipt of Certificate of Practical Completion or Provisional Certificate from the relevant highway authority) on behalf of the local planning authority prior to the occupation of the Stadium or April 2020, whichever is the soonest.

Condition : 48 - The development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the following details:
(i) Brentford Football Club, Drawing: OB Yard (Ref. 249889 - SK-047 - Issue 1, dated 17/04/18).
(ii) Method Statement (dated 10/06/2018).

Condition : 49 - Details of the cycle wheel channels that are to be provided on all steps are to be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority prior to occupation of any part of the development. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 50 - If any of the light emitting cells comprising the South Stand Video Screen fail and need to be replaced, the design and specification (including the directional hoods) shall be identical to that of the original fitting installed pursuant to this approval.

Condition : 51 - The intensity of the illumination of the South Stand Video Screen shall not exceed 1500cd/m2 in daytime hours or 300cd/m2 during the hours of darkness, as those terms are defined by the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989 (as amended) or any successor Regulations.

Condition : 52 - The South Stand Video Screen shall be fitted with a light intensity monitoring sensor to ensure the luminance intensity is dimmable to take account of ambient light conditions and comply with the maximum approved lighting intensity.
Condition : 53 - The South Stand Video Screen facing the M4 Elevated Motorway hereby permitted shall not be used for the purposes of advertising.

Condition : 54 - The North Stand and South Stand Video Screens hereby permitted shall not be operational outside of match and event days and shall not be operational:
(i)	For more than six hours on match days, and
(ii)	Outside 08:00 and 23:00 on event days.
The Video Screens shall not be used for a greater time than required for operational purposes.
